headline: Granted land development permits for a fire training facility at 201 Odlin Road and a minor subdivision at 8-10 Harlow Street.
summary: Granted a land development permit for a 24' x 66' fire training facility at 201 Odlin Road, conditioned on state approval of a SLODA modification before building permits are issued. Granted a land development permit for a minor subdivision at 8-10 Harlow Street for 2 commercial spaces and 14 dwelling units, conditioned on coordination with the Engineering Department on sidewalk and road restoration. Also adopted findings and decisions for Grandview Ave and 375 Pushaw Road.
decisions: Approved adoption of findings and decisions for Grandview Ave and 375 Pushaw Road, by roll call vote with all voting members in favor and none opposed.
Approved a finding that the 201 Odlin Road application was deemed complete on September 1, 2026, fees were paid, and the project is a Major Site Development and SLODA modification.
Approved a finding that the 201 Odlin Road project satisfied Land Development Code §165-33.1 on erosion and sediment control.
Approved a finding that the 201 Odlin Road project satisfied Land Development Code §165-58 on compliance with Federal Aviation Regulations.
Approved a finding that the 201 Odlin Road project satisfied Land Development Code §165-68 on lot frontage.
Approved a finding that the 201 Odlin Road project satisfied Land Development Code §165-79 on adequate utility service and stormwater provision.
Approved a finding that the 201 Odlin Road project satisfied Land Development Code §165-80 on water service from the Bangor Water District.
Approved a finding that the 201 Odlin Road project satisfied Land Development Code §165-83 on adequate electrical services.
Approved a finding that the 201 Odlin Road project satisfied Land Development Code §165-84 on surface water and storm drainage.
Approved a finding that the 201 Odlin Road project meets §165-95B requirements for uses within the Airport Development District.
Approved a finding that the 201 Odlin Road project satisfied Land Development Code §165-114C on access drives.
Approved a finding that the 201 Odlin Road project satisfied Land Development Code §165-114D on stormwater runoff.
Approved a finding that the 201 Odlin Road project satisfied Land Development Code §165-114G on building setbacks and effects on adjacent properties.

Granted the Land Development Permit for the 201 Odlin Road fire training facility, with the condition that the project receive SLODA modification approval from the Maine Department of Environmental Protection before building permits are issued.
Approved a finding that the 8-10 Harlow Street application was deemed complete on September 1, 2026, fees were paid, and the project is a Minor Subdivision.
Approved a finding that the 8-10 Harlow Street project satisfied Land Development Code §165-79, §165-80, and §165-83 on utility, water, sewer, and electrical services.
Approved a finding that the 8-10 Harlow Street project satisfied §165-82 on adequate fire protection.
Approved a finding that the 8-10 Harlow Street project meets §165-93B requirements for uses within the Downtown Development District.
Approved a finding that the 8-10 Harlow Street project meets §165-126F(1) on State of Maine subdivision guidelines.
Approved a finding that the 8-10 Harlow Street project meets §165-126F(2) and §165-126F(3) on lot dimensions and abutting an existing improved public road.
Approved a finding that the 8-10 Harlow Street project meets §165-126F(6) on plat information requirements.
Approved a finding that the 8-10 Harlow Street proposed subdivision meets the criteria under 30-A M.R.S.A. §4404 and the requirements of Article XVIII of the Land Development Code.

Granted the Land Development Permit for the 8-10 Harlow Street minor subdivision, with the condition that the applicant coordinate with the Engineering Department on sidewalk and road surface restoration and obtain any other required Engineering Department permits.
